At a Massachusetts community pharmacy, the pharmacist is on duty and available. Each proposed assignment below is evaluated with the employee’s current state license and certification. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A supervised nationally certified technician counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
A pharmacist performs final patient-specific prescription verification after an intern prepares the medication.
A pharmacy technician trainee accepts an unchanged verbal refill authorization for lisinopril.
A nationally certified technician receives an emergency oral oxycodone authorization directly from the prescribing practitioner.
A licensed nationally certified technician accepts a new verbal prescription for gabapentin with pharmacist approval.

Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

choices.text: A pharmacist assesses whether a clinically significant change warrants renewed counseling even though the patient has used the drug before.
A nationally certified technician explains a new medicine’s directions and important precautions as the clinical counselor.
A pharmacist records a patient’s actual refusal after offering available counseling.
A pharmacy provides a consultation area where the discussion can be visually and audibly confidential.
A pharmacist supplies or recommends a suitable measuring device with an oral liquid.

explanation.core_reasoning: 각 선택지는 별도 기록이다. 같은 약·업무 이름보다 자격, 실제 행위, 시작점과 예외를 비교한다. New therapy 뿐 아니라 pharmacist judgment 상 건강·안전에 중요한 therapy 에도 상담을 수행한다. 과거 복용 경험만으로 변경사항을 제외하지 않는다. Consultation area 는 visual·auditory confidentiality 를 제공해야 한다. 표지만으로 공간의 보호요건을 대신하지 않는다.
